<style>
/* LP · Intercorrências com Alinhadores
   Estilos de apoio às animações. Tudo é preso a classes (lp-*) aplicadas nos containers e
   widgets nativos do Elementor; layout, cores e tipografia ficam nos controles do painel. */

:root {
  --lp-noite: #011324;
  --lp-profundo: #0B2D4A;
  --lp-medio: #0E3C5E;
  --lp-turquesa: #00C2C7;
  --lp-azul-claro: #7ED3E6;
  --lp-texto: #C3D6E3;
  --lp-linha: rgba(126, 211, 230, .18);
  --lp-grad: linear-gradient(90deg, #07E3F3 0%, #00B5D0 50%, #0A92C4 100%);
  --lp-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { overflow-x: hidden; }
.lp { overflow-x: clip; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Entradas nativas do Elementor, suavizadas (fade-up 24px, 600ms, ease-out)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 24px, 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes fadeInLeft { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(-24px, 0, 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes fadeInRight { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(24px, 0, 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes zoomIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.94); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.lp .animated.animated-fast { animation-duration: .6s; animation-timing-function: var(--lp-ease); }
.lp .lp-pop.animated { animation-name: lpPop; animation-duration: .5s; }
@keyframes lpPop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); } 70% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.06); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Utilitários
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-grad, .lp .lp-grad { background: var(--lp-grad); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
.lp-hl { color: var(--lp-turquesa); }

/* Sobrelinha com traço antes */
.lp-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.lp-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title::before { content: ""; width: 28px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: currentColor; }
.lp-eyebrow--center .elementor-heading-title { justify-content: center; }
.lp-eyebrow--both .elementor-heading-title::after { content: ""; width: 56px; height: 1.5px; background: currentColor; opacity: .6; }
.lp-eyebrow--both .elementor-heading-title::before { width: 56px; height: 1.5px; opacity: .6; }

/* Brilho que passa uma vez no gradiente do título do hero */
.lp-shine { background: linear-gradient(100deg, #07E3F3 0%, #00B5D0 35%, #E9FDFF 50%, #00B5D0 65%, #0A92C4 100%); background-size: 250% 100%; background-position: 100% 0; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; animation: lpShine 1.6s .9s var(--lp-ease) 1 both; }
@keyframes lpShine { to { background-position: 0 0; } }

/* Botão primário: sobe 2px no hover e reflexo a cada 4s */
.lp-btn .elementor-button { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: transform .25s var(--lp-ease), box-shadow .25s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-btn .elementor-button::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 -60%; width: 40%; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, .55), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg); animation: lpSheen 4s 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
.lp-btn .elementor-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -12px rgba(0, 194, 199, .65); }
@keyframes lpSheen { 0% { left: -60%; } 30%, 100% { left: 130%; } }
.lp-btn--ghost .elementor-button { transition: transform .25s var(--lp-ease), background-color .25s, border-color .25s; }
.lp-btn--ghost .elementor-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.lp-btn--full, .lp-btn--full .elementor-button { width: 100%; }

/* Órbitas (anéis finos que giram) e brilho que pulsa */
.lp-orbits { position: relative; }
.lp-orbits::before, .lp-orbits::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.lp-orbits::before { width: var(--o1, 820px); height: var(--o1, 820px); left: var(--o1x, 60%); top: var(--o1y, -10%); border: 1px solid rgba(126, 211, 230, .16); border-top-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .55); animation: lpSpin 80s linear infinite; }
.lp-orbits::after { width: var(--o2, 1100px); height: var(--o2, 1100px); left: var(--o2x, 52%); top: var(--o2y, -24%); border: 1px solid rgba(126, 211, 230, .10); border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .4); animation: lpSpin 90s linear infinite reverse; }
.lp-orbits > .e-con:not(.lp-glow):not(.lp-dots), .lp-orbits > .e-con-inner, .lp-orbits > .elementor-element:not(.lp-glow):not(.lp-dots) { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
@keyframes lpSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.lp-glow { position: absolute !important; width: var(--gs, 520px) !important; height: var(--gs, 520px); left: var(--gx, 50%); top: var(--gy, 50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 194, 199, .9), rgba(0, 194, 199, 0) 68%); opacity: .2; animation: lpPulse 5s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0 !important; }
@keyframes lpPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: .15; } 50% { opacity: .25; } }

/* Revelação por classe (IntersectionObserver adiciona .is-inview uma vez) */
.lp-io { --lp-io: 1; }
.lp-js .lp-io:not(.is-inview) { --lp-io: 0; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   00 · Barra superior e 02 · Faixas: marquee
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-marquee { overflow: hidden; }
.lp-marquee__track { flex-wrap: nowrap !important; width: max-content !important; max-width: none !important; animation: lpMarquee var(--lp-speed, 30s) linear infinite; will-change: transform; }
.lp-marquee--rev .lp-marquee__track { animation-direction: reverse; }
.lp-marquee:hover .lp-marquee__track { animation-play-state: paused; }
.lp-marquee__track > .elementor-element { flex: none !important; width: auto !important; }
.lp-marquee__track .elementor-heading-title { white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.lp-marquee__track .elementor-heading-title::after { content: var(--lp-sep, "•"); margin-left: var(--lp-sep-gap, 28px); opacity: .7; }
@keyframes lpMarquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

.lp-topbar { --lp-speed: 30s; }
.lp-ribbons { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.lp-ribbon { position: absolute !important; left: -5%; width: 110% !important; --lp-sep: "✦"; --lp-sep-gap: 30px; --lp-speed: 40s; }
.lp-ribbon--back { top: 22px; transform: rotate(1.6deg); }
.lp-ribbon--front { top: 26px; transform: rotate(-1.6deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   01 · Hero
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-hero { --o1: 820px; --o1x: 58%; --o1y: -12%; --o2: 1100px; --o2x: 50%; --o2y: -26%; overflow: hidden; }
.lp-hero-visual { position: relative; }
.lp-hero-visual::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 1100px; height: 1100px; left: 18%; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-28deg); border-radius: 50%; border: 70px solid transparent; border-left-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .95); border-top-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .35); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(0, 194, 199, .35)); pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.lp-hero-visual > .elementor-element { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.lp-float img { animation: lpFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes lpFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } }
.lp-method .elementor-heading-title span { color: var(--lp-turquesa); margin: 0 8px; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03 · Dor: cena do paciente
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-scene { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1120 / 760; }
.lp-scene canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.lp-scene__ring { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 44%; width: 24%; aspect-ratio: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.85); border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(0, 194, 199, .8); opacity: 0; transition: all .5s; pointer-events: none; }
.lp-scene__ring::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(126, 211, 230, .25); }
.lp-scene__ring.is-show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
.lp-scene__label { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 9%; transform: translate(-50%, 8px); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(1, 19, 36, .75); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 194, 199, .5); color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.2 Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; transition: all .4s; }
.lp-scene__label.is-show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
.lp-scene__label b { color: var(--lp-turquesa); letter-spacing: .15em; }
.lp-scene__prog { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.lp-scene__prog span { width: 4px; height: 28px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(126, 211, 230, .2); transition: background .4s; }
.lp-scene__prog span.is-on { background: var(--lp-turquesa); }
.lp-dor-chip .elementor-heading-title::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lp-turquesa); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--lp-turquesa); vertical-align: middle; }
.lp-dor-row { transition: all .45s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-dor-row .elementor-heading-title { transition: color .45s; }
.lp-dor-row.is-on { border-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .7) !important; background-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .12) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 194, 199, .25), 0 12px 30px -12px rgba(0, 194, 199, .5); transform: translateX(6px); }
.lp-dor-row.is-on .elementor-heading-title { color: #fff !important; }
.lp-dor-row.is-on .lp-dor-num .elementor-heading-title { color: var(--lp-turquesa) !important; }
.lp-dor-q .elementor-heading-title { background: var(--lp-grad); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; opacity: .25; transition: opacity .6s; }
.lp-dor-q.is-on .elementor-heading-title { opacity: 1; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03b · Sem critério: frase de impacto
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-impact { position: relative; overflow: hidden; --o1: 900px; --o1x: 74%; --o1y: 57%; --o2: 700px; --o2x: 80%; --o2y: 69%; }
.lp-impact::before, .lp-impact::after { border-color: rgba(11, 45, 74, .08); border-top-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .25); }
.lp-dots { position: absolute !important; left: 0; top: 0; width: 616px !important; height: 392px; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(11, 45, 74, .18) 1.6px, transparent 1.7px); background-size: 28px 28px; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 30%, transparent 75%); mask-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 30%, transparent 75%); pointer-events: none; }
.lp-impact-word { --fill: 100%; }
.lp-impact-word .elementor-heading-title { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #07E3F3 0%, #00B5D0 calc(var(--fill) * .5), #0A92C4 var(--fill), rgba(11, 45, 74, .14) var(--fill)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; display: inline-block; transform-origin: 50% 60%; }
.lp-impact-line svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.lp-impact-line path { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: var(--draw, 0); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03c · Consequências
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-cost { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.lp-cost::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 3px; width: 100%; background: var(--lp-grad); transform: scaleX(var(--lp-io)); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 1.2s .2s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-sweep .lp-grad { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #07E3F3, #00B5D0, #0A92C4, rgba(255, 255, 255, .25) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .25)); background-size: 200% 100%; background-position: 100% 0; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; transition: background-position 1.4s .2s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-sweep.is-inview .lp-grad { background-position: 0 0; }
.lp-conseq-card .elementor-counter { display: block; }
.lp-conseq-card .elementor-counter-number-wrapper { justify-content: flex-start; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   04 · Apresentação: seta que se desenha
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-arrow { position: relative; height: 34px; }
.lp-arrow::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 4px; width: 2px; height: 22px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--lp-turquesa); transform: scaleY(var(--lp-io)); transform-origin: top; transition: transform .5s .2s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-arrow::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 4px; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-left: -4px; border-right: 2px solid var(--lp-turquesa); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--lp-turquesa); transform: rotate(45deg); opacity: var(--lp-io); transition: opacity .2s .65s; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   05 · Por dentro: carrossel com slide central em destaque
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-pages .swiper-slide { transition: transform .5s var(--lp-ease), opacity .5s; transform: scale(.8); opacity: .55; }
.lp-pages .swiper-slide-next { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; z-index: 2; }
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .lp-pages .swiper-slide { transform: scale(.64); opacity: .35; }
  .lp-pages .swiper-slide-next, .lp-pages .swiper-slide-next + .swiper-slide + .swiper-slide { transform: scale(.8); opacity: .7; }
  .lp-pages .swiper-slide-next + .swiper-slide { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; z-index: 2; }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .lp-pages .swiper-slide, .lp-pages .swiper-slide-next { transform: scale(.86); opacity: .5; }
  .lp-pages .swiper-slide-active { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}
.lp-pages .lp-page-cap { transition: opacity .4s; }
.lp-page-img img { box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); cursor: zoom-in; transition: transform .4s var(--lp-ease); }
@media (hover: hover) and (min-width: 1025px) {
  .lp-page-img { perspective: 900px; }
  .lp-page-img img:hover { transform: rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-5deg) translateY(-4px); }
}
.lp-inside { overflow: hidden; --o1: 900px; --o1x: 2%; --o1y: -25%; --o2: 800px; --o2x: 60%; --o2y: 25%; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   06 · Agenda
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-agenda { --o1: 760px; --o1x: -14%; --o1y: 12%; --o2: 600px; --o2x: -10%; --o2y: 16%; }
.lp-agenda::before, .lp-agenda::after { border-color: rgba(11, 45, 74, .07); border-top-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .25); }
.lp-agenda-bar { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.lp-agenda-bar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: var(--lp-p, 20%); border-radius: inherit; background: var(--lp-grad); transition: width .4s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-legend .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(1) i { color: #00C2C7; }
.lp-legend .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(2) i { color: #0A92C4; }
.lp-legend .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(3) i { color: #7ED3E6; }
.lp-legend .elementor-icon-list-item:nth-child(4) i { color: #0B2D4A; }
.lp-slots { position: relative; }
.lp-now { position: absolute !important; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; transform: translateY(var(--lp-now, 262px)); transition: transform .15s linear; }
.lp-now::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 2px; margin-left: 10px; background: var(--lp-turquesa); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 194, 199, .6); }
.lp-slot-card { transition: background .45s var(--lp-ease), border-color .45s, box-shadow .45s, transform .45s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-slot-card .elementor-heading-title, .lp-slot-card .elementor-widget-text-editor { transition: color .45s; }
.lp-slot-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 19px; top: 50%; width: 4px; height: 52px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--lp-cat, #00C2C7); }
.lp-cat-1 { --lp-cat: #00C2C7; } .lp-cat-2 { --lp-cat: #0A92C4; } .lp-cat-3 { --lp-cat: #7ED3E6; } .lp-cat-4 { --lp-cat: #0B2D4A; }
.lp-slot-done, .lp-slot-chip { display: none !important; }
.lp-slot.is-done .lp-slot-done { display: block !important; }
.lp-slot.is-done .lp-slot-num { display: none !important; }
.lp-slot.is-done .lp-slot-card { background: #F4F8FB; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0E3C5E, #011324) !important; border-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .55) !important; box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -20px rgba(1, 19, 36, .6); transform: scale(1.02); }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-card::before { height: 84px; background: var(--lp-turquesa); }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-chip { display: block !important; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-meta .elementor-heading-title { color: var(--lp-azul-claro) !important; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-title .elementor-heading-title { color: #fff !important; font-size: 21px; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-q, .lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-q * { background: var(--lp-grad); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent !important; font-weight: 600; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-num .elementor-heading-title { color: var(--lp-turquesa) !important; font-size: 40px; }
.lp-slot.is-active .lp-slot-time .elementor-heading-title { color: var(--lp-turquesa) !important; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   07 · Teste de compatibilidade: interruptores e medidor
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-fit { overflow: hidden; }
.lp-switch { position: relative; padding-right: 92px !important; cursor: default; transition: background-color .35s var(--lp-ease), border-color .35s; }
.lp-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 24px; top: 50%; width: 46px; height: 26px; margin-top: -13px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .14); transition: background .3s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 46px; top: 50%; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: -10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3); transition: right .3s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-switch.is-on { background-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .22) !important; border-color: rgba(0, 194, 199, .55) !important; }
.lp-switch.is-on::before { background: var(--lp-turquesa); }
.lp-switch.is-on::after { right: 27px; }
@media (hover: hover) and (min-width: 1025px) { .lp-switch--yes { cursor: pointer; } }
.lp-switch--no::before { background: #D5DEE6; }
.lp-strike p { display: inline; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 0 55%; background-size: calc(var(--lp-io) * 100%) 1px; transition: background-size 1s .3s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-meter-ring { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(var(--lp-turquesa) calc(var(--lp-deg, 0) * 1deg), rgba(255, 255, 255, .12) 0); transition: box-shadow .6s; }
.lp-meter-ring::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0B2D4A; }
.lp-meter.is-full .lp-meter-ring { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(0, 194, 199, .18), 0 0 30px rgba(0, 194, 199, .7); }
.lp-meter-full { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); transition: all .5s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-meter.is-full .lp-meter-full { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   08 · Bônus e oferta
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-play .elementor-icon { position: relative; }
.lp-play .elementor-icon::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--lp-turquesa); animation: lpRing 2.2s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes lpRing { from { transform: scale(.9); opacity: .9; } to { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; } }
.lp-old .elementor-heading-title { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
.lp-old .elementor-heading-title::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; top: 52%; height: 2px; background: #E5484D; transform: scaleX(var(--lp-io)) rotate(-6deg); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .7s .3s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-steps { position: relative; }
.lp-steps::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -14px; height: 2px; background: var(--lp-grad); transform: scaleX(var(--lp-io)); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 1.6s .2s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-mbar { position: fixed !important; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; z-index: 999; transform: translateY(140%); transition: transform .4s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-mbar.is-visible { transform: none; }
.elementor-editor-active .lp-mbar { position: relative !important; transform: none; left: auto; right: auto; bottom: auto; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   09 · Garantia, autora, FAQ
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.lp-seal { position: relative; }
.lp-seal::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -9px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed rgba(0, 194, 199, .7); animation: lpSpin 40s linear infinite; }
.lp-author-photo { position: relative; }
.lp-author-photo::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 500px; height: 500px; left: 50%; top: 46%; margin: -250px 0 0 -250px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(11, 45, 74, .12); border-top-color: var(--lp-turquesa); animation: lpSpin 60s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }
.lp-author-photo > .elementor-element { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item-title-icon span > i { transition: transform .25s var(--lp-ease); }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item[open] .e-n-accordion-item-title-icon .e-opened > i { transform: rotate(45deg); }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item { transition: box-shadow .25s; }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item[open] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--lp-turquesa), 0 16px 40px -20px rgba(0, 194, 199, .55); border-radius: 18px; }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item[open] .e-n-accordion-item-title-icon { background: var(--lp-turquesa); color: #fff; }
.lp-faq .e-n-accordion-item-title-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: #EAF2F7; transition: background .25s; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   10 · Fechamento
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<script defer>
/* LP · Intercorrências com Alinhadores
   Interações que o Elementor não faz sozinho. Cada bloco procura as classes lp-* dos containers
   e widgets nativos e sai em silêncio se a seção não existir. GSAP + ScrollTrigger (cdnjs)
   cuidam do pin com scrub das seções 03 e 03b. Sem GSAP, tudo fica visível no estado final. */
(function () {
  if (window.__lpMotion) return;
  window.__lpMotion = true;

  var doc = document.documentElement;
  doc.classList.add('lp-js');
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var editMode = false;
  var hasGsap = function () { return !editMode && !!(window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger); };
  var $ = function (sel, root) { return (root || document).querySelector(sel); };
  var $$ = function (sel, root) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((root || document).querySelectorAll(sel)); };
  var clamp = function (v, a, b) { return Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v)); };
  var pad = function (n, l) { n = String(n); while (n.length < l) n = '0' + n; return n; };
  var title = function (el) { return el && (el.querySelector('.elementor-heading-title') || el); };

  /* Revela uma vez ao entrar na tela (threshold 20%). A checagem no scroll cobre saltos por
     âncora e scroll muito rápido, quando o elemento passa sem chegar a "entrar" na tela. */
  function onceInView(els, cb, threshold) {
    if (!els.length) return;
    var pending = els.slice(), tick = false;
    var fire = function (el) { var i = pending.indexOf(el); if (i > -1) { pending.splice(i, 1); cb(el); } };
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { io.unobserve(e.target); fire(e.target); } });
      }, { threshold: threshold || 0.2 });
      els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
    }
    var check = function () {
      tick = false;
      pending.slice().forEach(function (el) { if (el.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight * 0.8) fire(el); });
      if (!pending.length) window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
    };
    var onScroll = function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(check); } };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    check();
  }

  function initReveal() {
    onceInView($$('.lp-io'), function (el) { el.classList.add('is-inview'); });
  }

  /* 00 e 02 · Marquee: duplica os itens até cobrir duas larguras de tela */
  function initMarquee() {
    $$('.lp-marquee__track').forEach(function (track) {
      if (track.dataset.lpReady) return;
      track.dataset.lpReady = '1';
      var items = $$(':scope > .elementor-element', track);
      if (!items.length) return;
      var guard = 0;
      while (track.scrollWidth < window.innerWidth * 1.2 && guard++ < 12) {
        items.forEach(function (it) { track.appendChild(it.cloneNode(true)); });
      }
      $$(':scope > .elementor-element', track).forEach(function (it) {
        var c = it.cloneNode(true); c.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); track.appendChild(c);
      });
    });
  }

  /* 03 · Dor: cena de 150 quadros dirigida pelo scroll */
  function initScene() {
    var box = $('.lp-scene');
    var sec = box && box.closest('.lp-dor');
    if (!sec) return;
    var cv = $('canvas', box), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    var tpl = box.getAttribute('data-frames'), N = parseInt(box.getAttribute('data-count'), 10) || 150;
    var stops = [];
    try { stops = JSON.parse(box.getAttribute('data-stops') || '[]'); } catch (e) { stops = []; }
    var rows = $$('.lp-dor-row', sec), q = $('.lp-dor-q', sec);
    var ring = $('.lp-scene__ring', box), lab = $('.lp-scene__label', box), bars = $$('.lp-scene__prog span', box);
    var imgs = new Array(N), want = 0, last = -1, started = false;

    function draw(k, force) {
      for (var j = k; j >= 0; j--) {
        var im = imgs[j];
        if (im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth) {
          if (j === last && !force) return;
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
          ctx.drawImage(im, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
          last = j;
          return;
        }
      }
    }
    function load() {
      if (started || !tpl) return;
      started = true;
      for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        (function (i) {
          var im = new Image();
          im.decoding = 'async';
          im.onload = function () { if (i === 0 || i <= want) draw(want, true); };
          im.src = tpl.replace('{n}', pad(i, 3));
          imgs[i] = im;
        })(i);
      }
    }
    function update(p) {
      want = Math.round(p * (N - 1));
      draw(want);
      rows.forEach(function (r, i) { var on = stops[i] ? p >= stops[i].from : p > 0.9; r.classList.toggle('is-on', on); if (bars[i]) bars[i].classList.toggle('is-on', on); });
      if (q) q.classList.toggle('is-on', p >= 0.9);
      var s = null;
      stops.forEach(function (st) { if (p >= st.from && p < st.to) s = st; });
      if (lab) {
        lab.classList.toggle('is-show', !!s);
        if (s) { lab.firstElementChild.textContent = s.n; lab.lastElementChild.textContent = s.t; }
      }
      if (ring) ring.classList.toggle('is-show', !!s && s.ring !== false);
    }

    onceInView([sec], load, 0);
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var pre = new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { if (e[0].isIntersecting) { load(); pre.disconnect(); } }, { rootMargin: '1200px 0px' });
      pre.observe(sec);
    } else { load(); }

    if (reduce) { update(1); return; }
    if (hasGsap()) {
      var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(min-width: 768px)', function () {
        ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: sec, start: 'top top', end: '+=300%', pin: true, anticipatePin: 1, onUpdate: function (st) { update(st.progress); } });
      });
      mm.add('(max-width: 767px)', function () {
        ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: sec, start: 'top 65%', end: 'bottom 35%', onUpdate: function (st) { update(st.progress); } });
      });
    } else {
      var tick = false;
      var calc = function () {
        tick = false;
        var r = sec.getBoundingClientRect(), vh = window.innerHeight;
        update(clamp((vh * 0.65 - r.top) / Math.max(1, r.height), 0, 1));
      };
      window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(calc); } }, { passive: true });
      calc();
    }
  }

  /* 03b · Sem critério: frase presa na tela, "improviso:" cresce e se preenche */
  function initImpact() {
    var sec = $('.lp-impact');
    if (!sec || reduce || !hasGsap()) return;
    var over = $('.lp-impact-over', sec), l1 = $('.lp-impact-l1', sec), word = $('.lp-impact-word', sec);
    var path = $('.lp-impact-line path', sec), hint = $('.lp-impact-hint', sec), dots = $('.lp-dots', sec);
    var build = function (tl) {
      tl.from([over, l1].filter(Boolean), { y: 40, autoAlpha: 0, stagger: 0.1, duration: 0.3 })
        .fromTo(word, { scale: 0.6, autoAlpha: 0 }, { scale: 1, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.35 }, '<0.15')
        .fromTo(word, { '--fill': '0%' }, { '--fill': '100%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'none' }, '<0.1');
      if (path) tl.fromTo(path, { '--draw': 1 }, { '--draw': 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'none' }, '<0.25');
      if (hint) tl.from(hint, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 10, duration: 0.2 }, '>-0.1');
      if (dots) tl.to(dots, { y: -60, duration: tl.duration(), ease: 'none' }, 0);
      return tl;
    };
    var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
    mm.add('(min-width: 768px)', function () {
      build(gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: sec, start: 'top top', end: '+=150%', pin: true, scrub: 0.6, anticipatePin: 1 } }));
    });
    mm.add('(max-width: 767px)', function () {
      build(gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power2.out' }, scrollTrigger: { trigger: sec, start: 'top 70%', toggleActions: 'play none none none' } })).timeScale(0.6);
    });
  }

  /* 06 · Agenda: a linha AGORA desce com o scroll e acende o card da vez */
  function initAgenda() {
    var wrap = $('.lp-slots');
    if (!wrap) return;
    var slots = $$('.lp-slot', wrap), now = $('.lp-now', wrap);
    var count = title($('.lp-agenda-count')), bar = $('.lp-agenda-bar');
    if (!slots.length) return;
    var current = -1, tick = false;
    function set(k) {
      if (k === current) return;
      current = k;
      slots.forEach(function (s, i) { s.classList.toggle('is-done', i < k); s.classList.toggle('is-active', i === k); });
      if (now) wrap.style.setProperty('--lp-now', Math.max(0, slots[k].offsetTop - 22) + 'px');
      if (count) count.textContent = pad(k + 1, 2);
      if (bar) bar.style.setProperty('--lp-p', ((k + 1) / slots.length * 100) + '%');
    }
    function calc() {
      tick = false;
      var ref = window.innerHeight * 0.45, top = wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top, k = 0;
      slots.forEach(function (s, i) { if (top + s.offsetTop <= ref) k = i; });
      set(k);
    }
    if (now) now.style.top = '0';
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(calc); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', calc);
    calc();
  }

  /* 07 · Teste de compatibilidade: interruptores ligam em sequência e o medidor acompanha */
  function initSwitches() {
    var list = $('.lp-switches');
    if (!list) return;
    var rows = $$('.lp-switch--yes', list), meter = $('.lp-meter'), ring = $('.lp-meter-ring');
    var num = title($('.lp-meter-num'));
    var total = rows.length;
    function refresh() {
      var n = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.classList.contains('is-on'); }).length;
      if (ring) ring.style.setProperty('--lp-deg', (n / total * 360).toFixed(1));
      if (num) num.textContent = n + '/' + total;
      if (meter) meter.classList.toggle('is-full', n === total);
    }
    refresh();
    onceInView([list], function () {
      rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
        setTimeout(function () { r.classList.add('is-on'); refresh(); }, reduce ? 0 : 300 + i * 140);
      });
    }, 0.3);
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (min-width: 1025px)').matches) {
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        r.setAttribute('role', 'switch');
        r.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        var toggle = function () { r.classList.toggle('is-on'); r.setAttribute('aria-checked', r.classList.contains('is-on')); refresh(); };
        r.addEventListener('click', toggle);
        r.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); } });
      });
    }
  }

  /* 08 · Barra fixa no celular: aparece depois do hero e some na oferta */
  function initMobileBar() {
    var bar = $('.lp-mbar'), hero = $('.lp-hero'), offer = document.getElementById('oferta');
    if (!bar || !hero) return;
    var tick = false;
    function calc() {
      tick = false;
      var afterHero = hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 0;
      var inOffer = false;
      if (offer) { var r = offer.getBoundingClientRect(); inOffer = r.top < window.innerHeight && r.bottom > 0; }
      bar.classList.toggle('is-visible', afterHero && !inOffer);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!tick) { tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(calc); } }, { passive: true });
    calc();
  }

  function init() {
    // No editor do Elementor: sem pin (o painel recarrega os elementos a todo momento).
    editMode = document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active') ||
      !!(window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.isEditMode && elementorFrontend.isEditMode());
    initMarquee();
    initReveal();
    initScene();
    initImpact();
    initAgenda();
    initSwitches();
    initMobileBar();
    if (hasGsap()) {
      window.addEventListener('load', function () { ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
